scope: Existing Hindsight shared local embedding/reranking cleanup; no ranking/model/filter/index changes.
review: Independent review of GC, corrected engine warmup and install/rollback; 11 focused tests pass. Earlier cross-encoder warmup rejected before deployment for parallel-loader dtype race.

stability.limitations: Finite synthetic stability test, not long-term leak proof. Mixed batch sizes stress p95 not improved versus short baseline; no p95 guarantee.

cold_start.status: Resolved in measured restart by synthetic inference after parallel loaders and dtype reset, before readiness

other_probe_failure: Transient core-container replacement during concurrent work caused postgres DNS failure before recall; preserved failed log, reran against stable current core.

data_preservation.configuration_diff: Hindsight image and opt-in variable only

limits: Full voice latency and acoustic playback unmeasured
Before/after on live workload, not randomized causal isolation
Prior baseline was ~2.55 seconds; fresh baseline 4.75 seconds, host load varies

index_check.existing: Vector HNSW, text GIN, bank/fact-type/date btree indexes present; pg_stat_user_indexes confirms use.

representative_text_explain.limitation: Simple representative text query, not complete actual recall query plan.

index_check.reason: Measured retrieval ~0.20s; model reranking including wait ~2.31s was main bottleneck.

post_gc_trace.limit: Parallel branches overlap; do not sum branch durations.

startup_warmup_limit: Moves GPU first-prediction work into startup; does not make overall boot instant. Await timeout cannot forcibly stop native GPU work; external readiness deadline and rollback retained.
